title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's AP-211 exam
question:
A bug is assigned to a developer stating that when an address contains data in the Address Line 2 field, the FlexCard display adds an additional line, causing formatting issues.
How should the developer handle this in a DataRaptor without changing the underlying data structures?
option_A: Modify the Extract DataRaptor to concatenate the address fields by using a formula.
option_B: Replace the Extract DataRaptor with a Transform DataRaptor to convert the data as needed.
option_C: Create a new Turbo Extract DataRaptor to trim the Address data in both fields.
option_D: Add a Load DataRaptor to write the data into one new custom field.
